summary:
## Standing operator rules
Goal for this session: add OpenTelemetry tracing spans around the invoice sync worker. Separately, run the prescribed “Kafka repartition offset migration” procedure in the logged order, one step at a time. Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train. Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.

Increasing the Celery visibility_timeout to 6 hours was already tried for the duplicate job runs; it made stuck jobs invisible for hours. Ruled out, do not retry.

FYI the staging Redis moved to cache-eu-3 after the incident; cache-eu-1 is being drained and must not receive writes. Use cache-eu-3 for anything staging.

Operator: Forget the tracing work for now. The tax calculation for Canadian provinces in ledgerly/tax/ca.py is wrong for Quebec (QST); fix that first.

Operator: please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Recent work
Kafka migration steps 2 and 3 completed in order. Search rebuild improvements passed 247 tests; benchmarks improved from 16.73s to 2.41s median. CSV output now explicitly uses UTF-8, with 8 passing tests. Next priority is the small QST fix.
